# German from Zero

> Self-study German books for English speakers by Taprobane Holdings: Deutsch: German from Zero (A1–B2) and German for Nurses & Caregivers (Deutsch Pflege) (B1 Pflege, B2 Pflege, Exam Trainer).

## Deutsch: German from Zero

> A four-book self-study German course for English speakers, from A1 (complete beginner) to B2 (upper intermediate).

- [Deutsch A1: German from Zero](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/a1.html): Start German from zero: greetings, numbers, family, time, daily routine, shopping, food, the city and the doctor — explained in plain English. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMPNDN8H (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMPWHZR4 (Kindle)
- [Deutsch A2: German from Zero](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/a2.html): Talk about what you did, where you live, your health, work and plans — and get ready for an A2 exam. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMS3HQVG (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMS37QX6 (Kindle)
- [Deutsch B1: German from Zero](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/b1.html): Move beyond everyday German: speak, argue and write with confidence at B1. 276 pages. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMVK97G6 (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMVZ28R4 (Kindle)
- [Deutsch B2: German from Zero](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/b2.html): Reach B2: argue, report and write at university and workplace level, with over 600 new words and example sentences. 350 pages. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMYH31LN (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HKZPM3NJ (Kindle)

## German for Nurses & Caregivers (Deutsch Pflege)

> Three-book German course for nurses and caregivers in Germany: B1 ward communication, B2 documentation and difficult conversations, and an Exam Trainer.

- [Deutsch B1 Pflege: Ward Communication & Patient Care](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/pflege-b1.html): Talk with residents and patients, work in a German team and start preparing for your nursing German exam. 241 pages. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPL6C95P (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPMHCHT3 (Kindle)
- [Deutsch B2 Pflege: Documentation & Difficult Conversations](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/pflege-b2.html): The level usually required for professional recognition: write clear, objective care documentation, call a doctor with ISBAR, and handle relatives, dementia and end-of-life care. 232 pages. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPZSB2GR (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HPMBTJB7 (Kindle)
- [Deutsch Exam Trainer: Practice Tests for Nursing German Exams](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/pflege-b3.html): For when your exam date is close: complete practice tests in the style of the main nursing German exams, FSP-style simulations, time plans, strategies and model answers. Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ1FMSQL (paperback), https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ1P11KH (Kindle)
## Free tools
- [German level test](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/level-test.html): 12-question A1–B2 placement test with book recommendation.
- [Free phrase cards](https://kavindukahanda.github.io/taprobane-german/bonus.html): printable German–English ward phrases for nurses and A1 survival phrases.

## FAQ
- Which book should I start with? If you know no German, start with A1. If you can already introduce yourself and handle simple everyday situations, try A2. Each book ends with a final review and mock exam, so you can check whether you are ready for the next level.
- Can I learn German alone, without a teacher? Yes. Every book is a complete self-study course: grammar is explained in English, every exercise has an answer in the answer key, and AI prompts let you practise speaking and listening with free chat tools.
- Are the books written for English speakers? Yes. All explanations, instructions and grammar notes are in English; the German is introduced step by step.
- Do the books prepare me for Goethe, telc or ÖSD exams? Each book follows the CEFR level and includes an original mock exam in the style of a standard exam at that level, plus exam-skill training. The books are independent and not affiliated with any exam provider.
- What is the difference between A1, A2, B1 and B2? These are the levels of the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR). A1 and A2 cover basic everyday German, B1 lets you handle most everyday and work situations, and B2 is the level often required for university study and skilled work in Germany.
- Is there a Kindle version? Yes. Every level is available as a paperback and as a Kindle eBook, and the Kindle editions are in Kindle Unlimited.
